label: Weft, a TypeScript framework
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,500;12..96,700;12..96,800&family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap');
  /* Weft: an open-source TypeScript framework whose idea is one thread - server and client code in the same file,
     woven at build time. Layout: the hero as the pitch (headline, the install command, a woven thread of light),
     then what it does as a bento of tiles, the code in tabs beside a live terminal, the numbers as bars, the voices,
     the adapters, the release, a closing call. */
  #sc-weft {
    --background: oklch(0.975 0.008 85);
    --foreground: oklch(0.22 0.03 270);
    --card: oklch(0.995 0.005 85);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --popover: var(--card);
    --popover-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.94 0.012 85);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.45 0.03 270);
    --border: oklch(0.22 0.03 270 / 0.14);
    --input: oklch(0.22 0.03 270 / 0.2);
    --primary: oklch(0.47 0.2 275);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.98 0.01 275);
    --secondary: oklch(0.94 0.02 275);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --accent: oklch(0.93 0.025 275);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.22 0.03 270);
    --ring: var(--primary);
    --radius: 0.75rem;
    --radius-sm: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 4px));
    --radius-md: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 2px));
    --radius-lg: var(--radius);
    --radius-xl: calc(var(--radius) + 4px);
    /* the second thread (a warm red through the indigo) and the ink that writes in the brand colour */
    --wf-thread: oklch(0.62 0.2 35);
    --wf-ink: oklch(0.45 0.2 275);
    --wf-note: oklch(0.93 0.11 95);
    --wf-note-ink: oklch(0.25 0.04 80);
    --wf-code: oklch(0.2 0.03 275);
    color-scheme: light;
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    overflow-x: clip;
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-family: 'Instrument Sans', var(--font-sans);
    container: sc-weft / inline-size;
  }
  #sc-weft[data-look='neon'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.16 0.03 280);
    --foreground: oklch(0.95 0.02 280);
    --card: oklch(0.2 0.035 280);
    --muted: oklch(0.23 0.035 280);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.78 0.04 280);
    --border: oklch(0.95 0.02 280 / 0.14);
    --input: oklch(0.95 0.02 280 / 0.2);
    --primary: oklch(0.84 0.14 200);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.18 0.04 220);
    --secondary: oklch(0.25 0.04 280);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --accent: oklch(0.27 0.05 280);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.95 0.02 280);
    --radius: 0.5rem;
    --wf-thread: oklch(0.72 0.24 340);
    --wf-ink: oklch(0.84 0.14 200);
    --wf-note: oklch(0.72 0.24 340);
    --wf-note-ink: oklch(0.16 0.03 280);
    --wf-code: oklch(0.12 0.03 280);
  }
  #sc-weft[data-look='blueprint'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.38 0.12 258);
    --foreground: oklch(0.98 0.01 250);
    --card: oklch(0.34 0.11 258);
    --muted: oklch(0.42 0.11 258);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.88 0.04 250);
    --border: oklch(0.98 0.01 250 / 0.45);
    --input: oklch(0.98 0.01 250 / 0.55);
    --primary: oklch(0.92 0.13 98);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.25 0.06 258);
    --secondary: oklch(0.44 0.11 258);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --accent: oklch(0.45 0.11 258);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.98 0.01 250);
    --radius: 0rem;
    --wf-thread: oklch(0.98 0.01 250);
    --wf-ink: oklch(0.92 0.13 98);
    --wf-note: oklch(0.98 0.01 250);
    --wf-note-ink: oklch(0.3 0.1 258);
    --wf-code: oklch(0.27 0.09 258);
  }
  #sc-weft [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  /* code in syntax colours: Shiki's token spans carry both themes; the listing's own ground picks one */
  #sc-weft [data-code-ground='light'] span[style*='--shiki-light'] {
    color: var(--shiki-light);
  }
  #sc-weft [data-code-ground='dark'] span[style*='--shiki-dark'] {
    color: var(--shiki-dark);
  }
  #sc-weft :is(h1, h2, h3) {
    font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', var(--font-sans);
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  #sc-weft code,
  #sc-weft kbd {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', var(--font-mono);
  }
  /* one 78rem column through every band */
  #sc-weft .wf-band {
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
    padding-block: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 6rem);
    padding-inline: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 78rem) / 2));
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-band[data-tone='muted'] {
    background: var(--muted);
  }
  #sc-weft[data-look='blueprint'] .wf-band[data-tone='muted'] {
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 55%, transparent);
  }
  /* Blueprint: the drafting grid behind the whole page, only in that look */
  #sc-weft .wf-grid {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: -1;
    color: oklch(0.98 0.01 250 / 0.13);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  #sc-weft:not([data-look='blueprint']) [data-for='blueprint'] {
    display: none;
  }
  /* the Site Header: the woven mark, the sections, the stars, the look and the mode */
  #sc-weft .mk-header {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 5;
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 82%, transparent);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: inherit;
  }
  #sc-weft .mk-header-inner {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
    max-width: none;
    min-height: 4.5rem;
    padding-inline: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 78rem) / 2));
  }
  #sc-weft :is(.mk-header-brand, .mk-footer-brand) {
    gap: 0.55rem;
    color: inherit;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-mark {
    flex: none;
    width: 1.75rem;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    background:
      repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary) 0 0.2rem, transparent 0.2rem 0.4rem),
      repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, var(--wf-thread) 0 0.2rem, var(--background) 0.2rem 0.4rem);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border);
  }
  #sc-weft :is(.mk-header-name, .mk-footer-brand-name) {
    color: inherit;
    font:
      800 1.5rem/1 'Bricolage Grotesque',
      sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #sc-weft .mk-header-nav {
    display: flex;
    margin-inline-start: auto;
  }
  #sc-weft .nav-menu-list {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  #sc-weft .nav-menu-link {
    color: inherit;
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  #sc-weft .mk-header-actions {
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-stars {
    gap: 0.35rem;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  /* the hero: the pitch over a woven thread of light */
  #sc-weft .wf-hero {
    overflow: clip;
    padding-block: clamp(4rem, 11vw, 8.5rem) clamp(4rem, 9vw, 7rem);
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-hero > .shader {
    opacity: 0.4;
  }
  /* a shade behind the copy keeps the light from running through the words */
  #sc-weft .wf-hero::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: -1;
    background: radial-gradient(70% 80% at 30% 45%, var(--background) 25%, transparent 80%);
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-hero-copy {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    max-width: 50rem;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-release {
    justify-self: start;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.35rem 1.4rem 0.35rem 0.9rem;
    background: var(--foreground);
    color: var(--background);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-release:is(:hover, :focus-visible) {
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-hero h1 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 7.5vw, 5.75rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 0.95;
    letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  }
  /* the turning word: its window is taller than the headline's tight lines (1lh of 1.25, the glyphs' whole height),
     so no edge of the next word shows; the negative margins keep the line as tight as the others. It closes the
     first line - the window is as wide as its longest word, so nothing follows it on the line */
  #sc-weft .wf-hero h1 .text-rotate {
    --text-rotate-duration: 9s;
    margin-block: -0.15em;
    color: var(--wf-ink);
    line-height: 1.25;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-lede {
    max-width: 38rem;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: clamp(1.0625rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
    line-height: 1.55;
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
  /* the thread under the headline: one line, woven over and under, drawn while you read */
  #sc-weft .wf-thread {
    display: block;
    width: min(100%, 34rem);
    height: 1.75rem;
    overflow: visible;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-thread path {
    fill: none;
    stroke-width: 3;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-dasharray: 1;
    stroke-dashoffset: 1;
    animation: wf-draw 2.4s 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.6, 0, 0.2, 1) forwards;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-thread path:first-child {
    stroke: var(--primary);
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-thread path:last-child {
    stroke: var(--wf-thread);
    animation-delay: 0.7s;
  }
  @keyframes wf-draw {
    to {
      stroke-dashoffset: 0;
    }
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-cta {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  /* the install command: a pill you can copy */
  #sc-weft .wf-install {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    max-width: 100%;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.4rem 0.4rem 1rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--card);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #sc-weft[data-look='blueprint'] .wf-install {
    border-radius: 0;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-install code {
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-install code::before {
    content: '$ ';
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  /* the sticky note: pinned at a slant, saying the one thing people do not believe */
  #sc-weft .wf-note {
    position: absolute;
    inset-block-start: clamp(7rem, 16vw, 10rem);
    inset-inline-end: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 78rem) / 2));
    max-width: 14rem;
    padding: 1rem 1.1rem 1.2rem;
    rotate: 4deg;
    background: var(--wf-note);
    color: var(--wf-note-ink);
    box-shadow: 0 0.75rem 1.5rem -0.75rem oklch(0 0 0 / 0.35);
    font:
      600 1rem/1.35 'Bricolage Grotesque',
      sans-serif;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-note::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset-block-start: -0.6rem;
    inset-inline-start: 40%;
    width: 4.5rem;
    height: 1.2rem;
    rotate: -6deg;
    background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.55);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.15);
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-note small {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 0.4rem;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-facts {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem 1.75rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-facts b {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  /* the shapes: a cube, an orb, a prism and a spark drifting in the hero's corner - the parts weft weaves together */
  #sc-weft .wf-shapes {
    position: absolute;
    inset-block-end: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
    inset-inline-end: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 78rem) / 2));
    width: 17rem;
    height: 15rem;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-shape {
    position: absolute;
    display: block;
    animation: wf-float 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-shape[data-shape='cube'] {
    inset: 0 auto auto 2rem;
    width: 6.5rem;
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1.15;
    background-color: var(--primary);
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-shape[data-shape='orb'] {
    inset: 5.5rem 0 auto auto;
    width: 5.5rem;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    background-color: var(--wf-thread);
    animation-delay: -2s;
    animation-duration: 8s;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-shape[data-shape='hex'] {
    inset: auto auto 0 6.5rem;
    width: 5rem;
    aspect-ratio: 1.15;
    background-color: var(--wf-note);
    rotate: 12deg;
    animation-delay: -4s;
    animation-duration: 9s;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-shape[data-shape='spark'] {
    inset: 1rem 2rem auto auto;
    width: 2.25rem;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    background-color: var(--wf-ink);
    animation-name: wf-twinkle;
    animation-duration: 3s;
  }
  @keyframes wf-float {
    to {
      translate: 0 -0.9rem;
      rotate: 6deg;
    }
  }
  @keyframes wf-twinkle {
    to {
      scale: 0.6;
      rotate: 45deg;
    }
  }
  /* the logos: a heading over the teams who ship on it, rolling */
  #sc-weft .mk-logos {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem);
    padding-inline: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 78rem) / 2));
    border-block: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-logos-head {
    display: grid;
    justify-items: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    text-align: center;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-logos-head h2 {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    line-height: 1.1;
  }
  #sc-weft .mk-logo {
    color: inherit;
  }
  #sc-weft .mk-logo-name {
    font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  /* section heads */
  #sc-weft .mk-section-header {
    margin-block-end: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  }
  #sc-weft .mk-section-header-eyebrow {
    color: var(--wf-ink);
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  #sc-weft .mk-section-header-title {
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.25rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    line-height: 1;
  }
  /* what it does: a bento of tiles, each with its own proof */
  #sc-weft .wf-bento {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-tile {
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    min-height: 15rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--card-foreground);
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-tile[data-span='4'] {
    grid-column: span 4;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-tile[data-span='3'] {
    grid-column: span 3;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-tile[data-span='2'] {
    grid-column: span 2;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-tile h3 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.375rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-tile p {
    margin: 0;
    max-width: 32rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-tile .mockup-code {
    margin-top: auto;
  }
  /* the split: a rule beside each line says which side it runs on, a sticker on the window says where it is cut */
  #sc-weft .wf-code-wrap {
    position: relative;
    margin-top: auto;
    padding-top: 0.5rem;
  }
  #sc-weft [data-wf-side='server'] {
    box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--wf-thread);
  }
  #sc-weft [data-wf-side='client'] {
    box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--primary);
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-split {
    position: absolute;
    inset-block-start: -0.35rem;
    inset-inline-end: 1.25rem;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.8rem;
    rotate: 3deg;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--foreground);
    color: var(--background);
    font:
      600 0.8125rem/1.2 'JetBrains Mono',
      monospace;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-split svg {
    width: 0.9rem;
    height: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--wf-thread);
  }
  .dark #sc-weft[data-look='blueprint'] .wf-split svg {
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-tile > .shader {
    opacity: 0.7;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-tile[data-tile='islands'] {
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-tile[data-tile='islands']::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: -1;
    background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--card) 35%, transparent 85%);
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-tile[data-tile='config'] {
    background-color: var(--muted);
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-badge-shape {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 3.25rem;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
  }
  /* the size: a starburst sticker with the number */
  #sc-weft .wf-burst {
    position: absolute;
    inset-block-start: 1rem;
    inset-inline-end: 1rem;
    display: grid;
    place-content: center;
    width: 6.5rem;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    rotate: -10deg;
    background: var(--wf-thread);
    color: oklch(0.99 0 0);
    text-align: center;
    font:
      800 1.25rem/1 'Bricolage Grotesque',
      sans-serif;
  }
  #sc-weft[data-look='blueprint'] .wf-burst {
    color: oklch(0.3 0.1 258);
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-tile:has(.wf-burst) :is(h3, p:not([style])) {
    margin-inline-end: 6.5rem;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-burst small {
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-routes {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    margin: auto 0 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
    font:
      0.875rem/1.5 'JetBrains Mono',
      monospace;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-routes li {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: var(--muted);
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-routes span {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  /* hot reload: the number circled by hand */
  #sc-weft .wf-hmr {
    margin-top: auto;
    color: var(--foreground);
    font:
      800 clamp(3rem, 7vw, 4.5rem) / 1 'Bricolage Grotesque',
      sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-circled {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-block;
    padding-inline: 0.15em;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-circled svg {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -18% -12%;
    width: 124%;
    height: 136%;
    overflow: visible;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-circled path {
    fill: none;
    stroke: var(--wf-thread);
    stroke-width: 3;
    stroke-linecap: round;
  }
  /* the code and the terminal side by side */
  #sc-weft .wf-try {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: start;
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }
  #sc-weft .wf-try .tabs {
    min-width: 0;
  }
  #sc-weft .mockup-code pre {
    white-space: pre-wrap;
  }
  /* the terminal in a ring of light (a Shader on its edge) with a tag that says it is live */
  #sc-weft .wf-shell-frame {
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
